title: Lovely Smoky Greek Lamb Skewers
description: Quick-fix Greek dish featuring smoky lamb skewers with parmesan cheese, flambe, and a side of tangy tzatziki sauce, all made on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle over medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Cook the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the parmesan cheese and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Once the lamb is done, brush the cheese mixture onto the skewers and flambe with a kitchen torch or under the broiler for 1-2 minutes.
Serve the lamb skewers hot with a side of tzatziki sauce and garnish with minced garlic.
Repeat with remaining ingredients if necessary.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
